stories.headline: Delhi Quietly Rejected Trump's Soft Pitch For U.S. Stealth Fighters That Turkey & Saudi Chase
stories.summary: India has declined the US offer to purchase F-35 stealth fighter jets, signaling a shift in its bilateral strategies with the US. The decision comes after US President Donald Trump imposed a 25% tariff on Indian imports, which took effect on August 7. India had been considering the acquisition of the fifth-generation aircraft, but has instead opted for self-reliance. The US had floated the pitch to supply India with the advanced Lockheed Martin F-35 jets, with Trump publicly stating that Washington was paving the way for the provision. However, India has formally informed the US that it will not proceed with the acquisition, marking a significant development in the country's defense ties with the US. The move highlights India's push for strategic autonomy, with the country having also rejected offers to purchase the Russian Su-57.

stories.headline: Nigeria joins Saudi-led Red Sea defence alliance
stories.summary: Nigeria has joined a Saudi-led multinational naval alliance aimed at protecting commercial shipping and global energy routes in the Red Sea and surrounding waterways. The alliance, established by Saudi Arabia, also has the support of 12 other countries. The initiative seeks to safeguard shipping lanes in the Red Sea, the Bab al-Mandab Strait, and the Gulf of Aden. Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Defence announced the establishment of the alliance, with participating countries committing to protect international shipping routes and global trade. The move comes as part of efforts to ensure the security of vital waterways and prevent disruptions to global commerce. Nigeria's decision to back the alliance underscores the importance of regional cooperation in maintaining maritime security and promoting economic stability. The alliance is expected to enhance collaboration among member states to address common security challenges.

stories.headline: Mixed-marriage families urge priority in Indonesia's dual citizenship plan
stories.summary: Indonesia's mixed-marriage families are urging the government to prioritize their needs in the country's dual citizenship plan. Currently, Indonesia does not recognize dual citizenship for adults, with the exception of children born to mixed-nationality parents, who can hold both nationalities until age 18 and must choose one by age 21. The government has been discussing the possibility of allowing dual citizenship, with President Jokowi previously promising to address the issue in 2015. However, no progress has been made, with Minister Luhut Pandjaitan suggesting that the country is not yet ready to adopt dual citizenship. The proposed plan could have significant implications, including increased demand for real estate, potentially leading to higher property values and rental incomes. Mixed-marriage families are pushing for a more inclusive approach to dual citizenship.

stories.headline: Morning Briefing: Aug. 2, 2026
stories.summary: An improvised explosive device detonated in central Moscow, targeting a ceremony honoring elite paratroopers and veterans. In other news, nearly 69,500 migrants have returned to Morocco from Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta in the last 30 hours. Indian President Murmu has given her assent to the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026, after it was cleared by both Houses of Parliament. The West Bengal Special Task Force arrested a terror suspect, Hamim Mondal, who allegedly had plans for subversive action during protests in Delhi. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Modi has launched a drugs-free youth campaign. Additionally, the Karnataka CM has requested the withdrawal of a bandh, and other key updates are emerging. These developments are part of the key news updates from around the world, including India, Spain, and Russia.

stories.headline: New Debian 13 “Trixie” Kernel Security Update Fixes 68 Vulnerabilities
stories.summary: Debian 13, code-named "Trixie", has received a critical kernel security update that addresses 68 distinct vulnerabilities across the operating system. The update is part of Debian 13.3, which brings together various security fixes and stability updates. Key package updates include upstream stable releases for Ansible, Apache2, Flatpak, Go components, PostgreSQL 17, QEMU, and the Linux kernel. Debian 13 "Trixie" features a new Linux kernel, desktop environments, and package upgrades. The distribution also includes support for RISC-V and Linux 6.12 LTS. APT 3.0 is also included, but with reduced support for 32-bit PCs. The latest point update, Debian 13.6, was released on July 11, 2026, with a collection of security fixes, critical bug corrections, and updated installation images, further enhancing the stability and security of the operating system.

stories.headline: Researchers develop full-color night vision goggles using a dual-emitter OLED upconverter device
stories.summary: Researchers have developed full-color night vision goggles using a dual-emitter OLED upconverter device. The device combines mercury telluride colloidal quantum dots, which absorb infrared light, and a dual-layer OLED that converts the absorbed energy into visible color. The OLED structure has two layers, one emitting red light and the other emitting cyan, with an energy barrier controlling charge flow. This allows the device to change both its emitted color and luminance depending on the wavelength and intensity of the incoming infrared light, effectively giving the wearer full-color infrared vision. The technology has been demonstrated in two applications: a wearable eyeglass and a next-generation retinal photoreceptor, enhancing ambient visible light and improving the user's night vision. The device improves upon previous upconverters, which output a single color and encode the infrared signal only as brightness.

stories.headline: Self-storage is quietly becoming an IT vertical
stories.summary: The self-storage industry is undergoing significant technological advancements, with digital locks and biometric identification becoming increasingly common. Data management software is also being utilized to protect data from viruses and unauthorized access. Artificial intelligence (AI) is being integrated into self-storage operations, with new products being released in 2026 to support this trend. While automation is improving efficiency, industry experts caution against removing human interaction entirely. The use of AI is reshaping the competitive landscape of the self-storage sector, with operators, developers, and investors exploring its potential to analyze data more efficiently and make faster decisions. Recent reports, such as Storable's Industry Pulse report, highlight the latest trends and market benchmarks in the self-storage industry, including the growing role of AI and technology in the sector.

stories.headline: 4 Cheaper Alternatives To Expensive Smart Home Sensors
stories.summary: Smart home sensors can be expensive, but affordable alternatives are available. IKEA and Sonoff offer cheaper options for those looking to automate their homes without breaking the bank. Other affordable alternatives include cheap Chinese Bluetooth LCD temperature and humidity sensors that can be customized with firmware for use with Home Assistant. These budget-friendly options can provide similar functionality to more expensive smart home sensors, making it possible for homeowners to upgrade to a smart home without a large upfront investment. With a wide range of manufacturers offering affordable smart home gadgets, it's now more accessible to transform a house into a smart home. These cheaper alternatives can provide a cost-effective entry point for those looking to start automating their homes and can eventually pay for themselves through energy efficiency and convenience.

stories.headline: [AP News] Women's Professional Baseball League makes a rainy debut in front of enthusiastic crowd
stories.summary: The Women's Professional Baseball League (WPBL) made its inaugural season debut on a rainy Saturday night, with the Los Angeles Queens facing off against the New York Heights. Despite the steady rain, a crowd of over 4,000 enthusiastic fans attended the game, with many lining up hours in advance to grab a Davis bobblehead. The league, the first women's professional baseball league in the US in almost 30 years, paid tribute to the past, present, and future of women's baseball during a pregame ceremony. Fans, including young softball players, expressed excitement about watching professional women play baseball. The crowd cheered as the lineups for the Queens and Heights were announced, showing support for the new league and its players. The WPBL's debut marks a significant milestone for women's baseball in the United States.

stories.headline: [mlb.com] Dodgers to acquire Tarik Skubal (source)
stories.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers are acquiring left-handed starter Tarik Skubal from the Detroit Tigers in a blockbuster trade. Skubal, a two-time AL Cy Young Award winner, will join the back-to-back champion Dodgers as they bid for a three-peat. The trade involves the Dodgers sending outfielder Zyhir Hope, right-hander River Ryan, and right-hander Brady Smith to the Tigers. The Dodgers were able to retain top pitching prospect Christian Zazueta in the deal. River Ryan, who debuted with the Dodgers in 2024, posted a 1.33 ERA across four starts before being traded. The acquisition of Skubal strengthens the Dodgers' pitching rotation as they pursue another championship title. The trade is seen as a significant move for the Dodgers, who are willing to pay a steep price to maintain their competitive edge.

stories.headline: [ESPN] Braves acquire OF Lane Thomas in 4-player trade with Royals
stories.summary: The Atlanta Braves have acquired outfielder Lane Thomas and minor league left-hander Bailey Falter from the Kansas City Royals in a 4-player trade. In exchange, the Braves sent minor league pitchers Carter Holton and Lucas Braun to the Royals. The move aims to shore up the Braves' outfield and pitching needs. Thomas and Falter are expected to bolster the Braves' roster ahead of the upcoming Trade Deadline. The acquisition of Thomas, in particular, addresses the team's outfield requirements, while Falter adds depth to the pitching staff. The trade was announced on Saturday, with both teams confirming the deal. The Braves are still seeking to acquire a frontline starting pitcher before the Trade Deadline on Monday.

stories.headline: [au.news.yahoo.com] Aussie gold medallist blasts 'horrible' act that saw star forced out of Commonwealth Games
stories.summary: Australian gold medallist Matt Richardson was forced to withdraw from the Commonwealth Games due to injury after a rival's "horrible" act. Footage has emerged of the incident, which has been labelled "disgraceful" and "appalling". Richardson, a Team England rider, was ruled out of the Games as a result of the incident. The Australian cycling team had previously poked fun at Richardson, referring to him as a "defector". The incident is the latest in a series of controversies at the Commonwealth Games, including protests over the men's 4x100m relay champions and the disqualification of Australian cyclist Felicity Wilson-Haffenden. The incidents have sparked outrage and debate among athletes and fans, with some calling for greater action to be taken against those responsible for the incidents. Richardson's withdrawal has been met with disappointment and concern for his well-being.

stories.headline: Gurgaon MNC employee dies by suicide, son records video as mother screams for help
stories.summary: A 36-year-old MNC employee in Gurgaon died by suicide, with his seven-year-old son recording a video of the incident on a mobile phone. The son allegedly filmed his father hanging while his mother, Manpreet Kaur, screamed for help. The incident occurred when only the couple and their son were present at home. The police reported that the mother immediately informed both her family and the deceased's relatives after the incident. The wife has been detained for questioning. The exact circumstances leading to the suicide are being investigated. The video recorded by the son shows the father hanging, with the mother's screams for assistance audible in the background. The police are currently examining the evidence and speaking with the family to determine the events surrounding the incident.

stories.headline: 'Rrs 18cr stolen every year': Raj Thackeray alleges Siddhivinayak temple donation scam
stories.summary: Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) founder Raj Thackeray has alleged that ₹18 crore in donations is being stolen every year from Mumbai's Siddhivinayak Temple. The claim comes amid a row over donations theft at the Ram Temple in Ayodhya. Thackeray also mentioned that ₹1,400 crore had been stolen at the Ram temple. The Siddhivinayak Temple trust has responded to the allegation, citing that arrests have been made in the past, implying that measures are being taken to prevent such incidents. The allegation has raised concerns about the management of donations at prominent temples in India. The MNS chief's statement has sparked attention and debate, with many seeking clarification and investigation into the matter. The temple trust's response suggests that they are taking steps to address the issue, but the extent of the problem remains to be investigated.

stories.headline: Students return to Jantar Mantar to debunk viral false protest videos
stories.summary: Students have returned to Jantar Mantar to debunk viral false protest videos, claiming that social media posts falsely showed fresh protests at the location. The students verified the claims with vendors and CCTV footage, and are planning to seek police action against the accounts that spread the misinformation. The protests at Jantar Mantar initially began over unmet demands, including the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, and irregularities in the NEET exam. Despite earlier confrontations between protesters and police, a viral video showed students offering pizza to police personnel, showcasing a moment of solidarity. The protest has also seen support from celebrities, including Naseeruddin Shah and Poonam Pandey, who have visited the site to show their support for the students' demands. The students' actions aim to clarify the situation and prevent the spread of false information.

stories.headline: Stone-pelting by CJP protesters happened even after Parliament march violence: Officials
stories.summary: Stone-pelting incidents by CJP protesters continued even after the violent Parliament march on July 20, with clashes occurring until July 25 when the protest ended. The violence was concentrated within a 2-kilometre radius of Parliament, with security officials stating that political elements infiltrated the student crowd to stoke violence. A damaged Maruti Eeco was involved in the incident, which was seized by police on July 16 after a crash that injured seven people. The CJP had claimed the vehicle was an MCD truck, but an investigation found it had been in police custody all along. The incidents occurred amid heightened security arrangements, with several protesters and police personnel injured in the clashes. The government eventually accepted the CJP's demands, including the resignation of the then education minister Dharmendra Pradhan, leading to the end of the protest.
